conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
if a > b
  console.log "Greater"
else
  console.log "Less"

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: coffeescript idiomatic implementation of while loop.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.code:
try
  throw new Error("Oops")
catch e
  console.log e.message
error_handling.notes: coffeescript idiomatic implementation of error handling.

comments.title: Comments & Script Headers
comments.notes: CoffeeScript uses # for comments with script headers.

numbers.title: Numbers & Arithmetic
numbers.notes: CoffeeScript supports shell integer arithmetic and numeric expressions.

booleans.title: Booleans & Exit Codes
booleans.notes: CoffeeScript evaluates boolean status through exit codes (0 = success) and boolean primitives.

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Coercion
type_casting.code:
str_val="42"
# Arithmetic context forces integer coercion
num=$((str_val + 0))
type_casting.notes: CoffeeScript handles type conversion explicitly via type accelerators [type] or arithmetic evaluation.

strings.title: Strings & Quoting
strings.code:
single='Literal single quotes'
double="Expanded: ${USER}"
multiline="Line 1
Line 2"
strings.notes: CoffeeScript differentiates between single quotes (literal) and double quotes (variable expansion).

string_formatting.title: String Interpolation
string_formatting.notes: CoffeeScript provides in-string variable interpolation and printf formatting.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Case
pattern_matching.notes: CoffeeScript matches patterns with case statements or switch blocks with glob matching.

range.title: Ranges & Sequences
range.code:
# Brace expansion
for i in {1..10..2}; do
    echo "$i"
done
range.notes: CoffeeScript constructs ranges with brace expansion {start..end} or range operators ..

iterators.title: Pipes & Iterators
iterators.code:
while IFS= read -r line; do
    echo "$line"
done < "file.txt"
iterators.notes: CoffeeScript streams data elements through command pipelines and loop iteration.

oop_classes.title: Classes / Structured Functions
oop_classes.notes: CoffeeScript defines reusable components through classes (PowerShell 5+) or modular functions.

lists.title: Arrays & Collections
lists.code:
items=("apple" "banana" "cherry")
items+=("date")
echo "${items[0]}" # apple
echo "${items[@]}" # all elements
lists.notes: CoffeeScript manages arrays using array lists @() or whitespace-delimited shell arrays.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: CoffeeScript emulates tuples through string delimiters, .NET Tuples, or positional variables.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Lists
sets.notes: CoffeeScript models unique sets using associative arrays or underlying runtime sets.

modules_import.title: Sourcing & Modules
modules_import.code:
# Source an external script
source ./utils.sh
# or: . ./utils.sh
modules_import.notes: CoffeeScript imports external functions using source (. in POSIX) or Import-Module.
